convergence_rationale: Rust (4 concurrent workspaces: codex-rs 67 members + helios-rs 62 members + root 9 + pheno-cli) + TypeScript (codex-cli pnpm) + Python (heliosBench, app.py, uv-managed) + Mojo (harness_mojo) + Zig (harness_zig) + Go (go/) + Bazel (MODULE.bazel + 29 workflows) + 22 thegent-* crates. Touches 7+ language ecosystems with multi-transport (stdio, MCP, OTEL, HTTP, TUI/PTY, sandbox landlock/seatbelt). 100+ workspace members across 4 Rust workspaces is a coordination surface that maps to 'convergence' but the actual repo is not a single convergence app — it is a multi-stack fork with duplicated Rust surfaces.

action_items.title: Collapse codex-rs + helios-rs + root + pheno-cli into one Cargo workspace or a clear owner per workspace
action_items.details: Three concurrent Rust workspaces (codex-rs 67 members, helios-rs 62 members as a helios-* renamed parallel, root 9 members) with separate lockfiles are an SOTA-blocker. Pick one of: (a) merge helios-rs/ back into codex-rs/ via path aliases (delete helios-rs/), (b) keep codex-rs/ as the vendored upstream and move HeliosCLI-specific crates into crates/ then add them to a single root workspace, (c) document the split with a registry that maps codex-* -> helios-* package names. Frees one workspace's Cargo.lock + bazel-bin cache and unblocks the next 3 items.

action_items.title: Deduplicate .github/dependabot.yaml vs .github/dependabot.yml and consume phenotype-dep-guard
action_items.details: Pick one (recommend .github/dependabot.yaml — has 12 ecosystems including cargo, devcontainers, docker, github-actions, rust-toolchain) and delete the other. Then point cargo-deny + cargo-machete + cargo-audit configs at the shared phenotype-dep-guard policy file. Single source of truth for the 4 weekly schedules.
